name: unsafe fn as_inner (& mut self) -> & mut Self :: Source
rule: Callers of `SourceIter::as_inner` may replace the returned reference only after stopping iteration, and must drop the iterator pipeline after extracting the source.
api: trait SourceIter  : { unsafe fn as_inner (& mut self) -> & mut Self::Source }
expression: The requirement cannot be expressed in the supplied DSL: it requires temporal observations for stopping iteration, replacing the reference, extracting the source, and dropping the pipeline.
